Tindahan — E-commerce Mobile App

A mobile shopping experience focused on quick browsing, honest prices and a two-step checkout.

Discuss a similar project ← All projects
Type

Category
UI/UX Design
Platform

Proposed tools
Mobile UI design · Prototyping · User flows
THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Long checkout flows and hidden shipping fees cause shoppers to abandon carts on mobile.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

Thumb-zone navigation, sticky add-to-cart, and shipping cost shown on the product page, not at the last step.

Key features

  • 01Product grid with quick add
  • 02Filters in a bottom sheet
  • 03Saved items
  • 04Two-step checkout
